{{Quote|You talk too much. Where's the big hairy one?|A Verhandle soldier to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />}}
The criminal [[Verhandle]] had a group of '''soldiers''' that protected him. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] refused to sell the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to him, Verhandle dispatched a group of soldiers to stow away aboard the ship and steal it in transit. The squad hid under the Falcon's floor panels, and managed to get the drop on Solo in the cockpit. Although the squad contained at least six members, Chewbacca managed to ambush the group and incapacitate them.<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />
